answer: Multipath RF attestation mitigates Sybil attacks by binding agent identities to local satellite signal reflections. Nodes authenticate by sampling phase distortions unique to their physical site, whether in an urban canyon or on a coastal jetty. An attacker incurs the verifiable cost of deploying separate GNSS receivers per identity to forge decorrelated phase profiles. However, orbital shadowing can turn a static sensor into an unresponsive relic, falsely rejecting honest agents.
